quests.title: Fungi Are Not Tidalga!

dialogue.sit: After a while, you and Paimon arrive at the Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta booth...

dialogue.t: Mmm! I love these soft, bouncy, smooth, squishy Fungi! Hehe, I want to keep playing!
I'm Enghiene, and I was Turenna's drillmaster before she entered the Special Patrol!
I'm nothing like her, you hear? Nothing! I'm not going to grovel before you just because you're Super Zenith Boss-Level Forces!
Uh, so this super arrogant Melusine... used to be Turenna's drillmaster?
Don't worry, Golden Comet, Silver Companion!
Ms. Turenna received new orders not long ago, and has returned to the Special Patrol's base.
Before departing, she asked Ms. Enghiene to watch the event area in her place.
She loves Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta, and we're always playing it.
That's right! I love both the tabletop game, and those round Fungi in real life!
They're soft, bouncy, smooth, and squishy... just like Tidalga... Hehehe...

dialogue.sit: You can't eat them! No eating Fungi!

dialogue.t: I won't! I just want to hold them and rub my face against them. Haniyyah didn't mind when I pinched Kindlejoy!
That's... That's the most you can do! Only we can hold Bongo-Head!
You're so stingy! I want them both!
Haniyyah said you're experts at the game. How about a round against me?
If I win, I'm going to hold and pinch Bongo-Head!
Grr, she's looking down on us!
Let's do this, {NICKNAME}! As early adopters of the game, we need to show her what we're made of!

dialogue.sit: We're also the first champions of the Nilotpala Cup!
And the Twin Stars of Brilliant Valor!

dialogue.t: We didn't earn these titles just to be this easily defeated!

quests.description: After Turenna’s departure, the event welcomes another special Melusine player…
